name: N.Ukeme
summary: N.Ukeme is a single-player bomb-maze arcade game for iPhone and iPad, played in portrait orientation. Players tap to move, double-tap to plant bombs, destroy walls, avoid moving enemies and reach each maze exit. Three guided training missions lead into stages across 12 European cities, from Warsaw to Istanbul. Players earn rewards for cosmetics and equipment and can replay completed stages. An optional cosmetic BPM Supporter Pack provides no gameplay advantage.
